Business Boarding.endpoint_description: This method is used for on-boarding the Business to the PayMate platform. Once the Business gets on-boarded to the PayMate platform, they can perform the various activities like: adding a card, boarding contacts, making payments to their vendors and sending collection request to their buyers.

request_parameters.description: A unique request no from the partner to track the request
Refer BusinessInfo object
Array of business charges. Minimum one to provide and these charges will be used during payment processing. Refer TransactionCharges Object

BusinessInfo.description: Company Registration no issued by the government. If registration number is provided by the partner then PayMate will perform the business KYC in real time. If the registration number is not provided then the Partner will have to use the BuyerSupplierKYC and ShareholderDetails API method for KYC verification.
Name of the business as per the government record.
Business unique reference no. on partner system
Contact's person name
Business Email which will be used for all future communication
If business will provide the country ISD code then system will validate and store the details
If business will provide the mobile no then system will validate the number else they can skip the details
Short description about the business
Business website details
Country 3 letter code(ISO alpha 3 code)
Y – if Business wants their vendors to perform the KYC, N – Otherwise

TransactionCharges.description: Payments: only for supplier payment. Collections: for only for collection. Otherwise set both the service type in case of business want to use both the service
Set payment mode as Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking and XpressAccount
MDR for each payment mode. This should be greater than or equal to given MDR to partner
Program Code defines the respective channel to be used during transaction. Required only in case of payment mode credit card

response_parameters.description: This will be used to show business status and respond. Refer DetailedSummary Object
